decisions.boundary_condition: Treat walking distance as the reusable threshold; use a stricter walk-time limit only when the current request explicitly supplies one
decisions.canonical_value: Prefer hotels on or within walking distance of the beach for coastal trips, subject to the current trip's budget and stated priorities.
decisions.condition: When searching for a hotel in a coastal or beach-oriented area
decisions.default_action: Prioritize properties on the beach or close enough to walk while also filtering to the trip's stated budget
decisions.exception_condition: Do not apply this preference to non-coastal trips or when the current trip names a different location priority
decisions.name: Prefer beach-proximate hotels
decisions.preference_value: A hotel on or near the beach, ideally within walking distance
decisions.rationale: Repeated examples across three hotel searches support a reusable preference for beach proximity in coastal destinations. The evidence supports walking distance as the general threshold, while the less-than-five-minute limit appears only in one request and should remain request-specific.
